reviewed_scope: Complete new wrapper authoring 2f4253bd3c56bda55a5e7d36928c6b8f53ca355a, scalar eligibility and reserved-name order.
Shared tape/frame source only as needed for type_code, normalize, scratch constants, pool/emit/label capture, call_function and generated literal-table bounds.
All incoming words saved before borrowed-byte guards; range and alias guard order; label serial and success/failure tails.
Measurement/fill reset and disjoint workspace ranges; immutable private source and manifest prerequisites.

findings.details: Absent exports, final wrapper-eligible signatures are exactly the width/bool parameters and at most one width/bool/unit return. Explicit exports are checked first. Parameter/return eligibility precedes the closed-runtime/loader reserved-name check; unit parameters and resources therefore skip rather than trigger that check. Actual admitted Core is required; this is not a foreign schema validator.

Shared TYPES maps unit=0, bool=1, i8/u8=2/3, i16/u16=4/5, i32/u32=6/7, i64/u64=8/9, isize/usize=10/11 and resources=12..15. normalize matches unit zero, bool and1, narrow signed/unsigned shifts and 64-bit no-op. Borrowed pointer and length words use type9 u64; result type7 is u32.

wrapper_capture completes every mixed scalar/loan word before wrapper_guards. Only rax is scratch during incoming saves; source words use rdi,rsi,rdx,rcx,r8,r9 then rbp+16+8*(i-6). Prologue touches every 4096-byte interval with r11 before captures, matching the reference.

Failure labels1..4 are allocated first in order. Every range performs extent before empty/null/address. A zero-length range skips null and overflow after extent. Only after all ranges are checked does i<j alias order run, skipping read/read and empty pairs and accepting adjacent non-overlapping intervals. Guard failure does not call Core or read/write caller bytes.

Each wrapper label increments serial before recording, and temporary range/disjoint names are copied into the tape pool before the same scratch slot is reused. Success calls the exact source-index internal function symbol and normalizes u32; failure tails are labels in1..4 order, rax=status<<32, leave, ret. Parent function-order/alignment/export-count/late text gates remain separate obligations.

findings.conclusion: No confirmed overlap in inspected ranges

findings.details: The write pass resets count, bytes and serial to the immutable original values and repeats the pure wrapper traversal. Exact count/bytes are checked afterward. Capacity GROW repeats pure generation and does not represent a second external call. Natural-u64 serial/size overflow produces a private ABI refusal; public bounds and original producer issuance still need combined tests.

limits: Source readback and SHA identities were checked; no code was executed, no AST parse was run and no current test counts are inherited.
The borrowed-byte selection request must come from the actual original manifest admission. Rechecks here deliberately do not replace normalize_exports or structured/Core/profile admission.
Matching source header/lease integers do not authenticate a replaced Graph. Fixed issuer must retain the same immutable admitted source and actual manifest request.

Complete Code-command consumer, fixed executor, real machine bytes, malformed private protocols, runtime memory safety, whole Emitter, backend, installation and cold qualification were not established by this review.
Upstream literal-table authoring assertions and referenced helper reachability were read, not executed.
